scope: Faithful algebra embeddings of the split D=2^f-character Gaussian algebra into a full power-two cyclic or negacyclic ring. Gaussian Eisenstein field factors and complete orthogonal idempotents are checked exactly. Positive cyclic N=4 nonmonomial encoding is retained. Arbitrary extension dimensions, multiple products, Toeplitz restrictions, nonhomomorphic operand encodings and the existing field-core-plus-border mechanism remain outside. No native cost or exponent.
